report: Code-Dependent: Pros and Cons of the Algorithm Age
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Net effect of algorithms
entries.quote: Will the net overall effect of algorithms be positive for individuals and society or negative for individuals and society?
entries.subject: algorithms and society
entries.note: Shares are printed in the 'About this canvassing' section. Horizon: 'what will happen in the next decade'.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = positives outweigh negatives; disagree = negatives outweigh positives

notes: One question from a canvassing of eight questions fielded 2016-07-01 to 2016-08-12. The question asks about 'the next decade' / 'the next 10 years' and names no year; target_year 2026 is read from that horizon (the jobs report itself says 'by 2026'). Non-random opt-in canvassing.
